MktCalcInsightObjectDef.expression: SELECT ssot__Individual__dlm.ssot__Id__c AS customer_id__c, ssot__Individual__dlm.ssot__FirstName__c AS first_name__c, ssot__Individual__dlm.ssot__LastName__c AS last_name__c, COUNT(ssot__FinancialAccount__dlm.ssot__Id__c) AS total_accounts__c, SUM(CASE WHEN ssot__FinancialAccount__dlm.ssot__FinancialAccountStatus__c = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_accounts__c, SUM(CASE WHEN Zentra_Recurring_Payment__dlm.Status_c__c = 'Stopped' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stopped_payments__c, SUM(CASE WHEN Zentra_Recurring_Payment__dlm.Status_c__c = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_payments__c, SUM(CASE WHEN Zentra_Dispute_Case__dlm.Dispute_Stage_c__c NOT IN ('Resolved','Rejected') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS open_disputes__c, COUNT(ssot__FinancialAccountTransaction__dlm.ssot__Id__c) AS txn_count__c, CASE WHEN COUNT(ssot__FinancialAccount__dlm.ssot__Id__c) = 0 THEN 80 ELSE CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN ssot__FinancialAccount__dlm.ssot__FinancialAccountStatus__c != 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 30 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN Zentra_Recurring_Payment__dlm.Status_c__c = 'Stopped' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > SUM(CASE WHEN Zentra_Recurring_Payment__dlm.Status_c__c = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) THEN 25 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN Zentra_Dispute_Case__dlm.Dispute_Stage_c__c NOT IN ('Resolved','Rejected') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 20 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN COUNT(ssot__FinancialAccountTransaction__dlm.ssot__Id__c) = 0 THEN 15 WHEN COUNT(ssot__FinancialAccountTransaction__dlm.ssot__Id__c) < 5 THEN 5 ELSE 0 END END AS churn_risk_score__c FROM ssot__Individual__dlm LEFT JOIN ssot__FinancialAccount__dlm ON ssot__FinancialAccount__dlm.ssot__OwnerId__c = ssot__Individual__dlm.ssot__Id__c LEFT JOIN ssot__FinancialAccountTransaction__dlm ON ssot__FinancialAccountTransaction__dlm.ssot__FinancialAccountID__c = ssot__FinancialAccount__dlm.ssot__Id__c LEFT JOIN Zentra_Recurring_Payment__dlm ON Zentra_Recurring_Payment__dlm.Customer_c__c = ssot__Individual__dlm.ssot__Id__c LEFT JOIN Zentra_Dispute_Case__dlm ON Zentra_Dispute_Case__dlm.AccountId__c = ssot__Individual__dlm.ssot__Id__c GROUP BY ssot__Individual__dlm.ssot__Id__c, ssot__Individual__dlm.ssot__FirstName__c, ssot__Individual__dlm.ssot__LastName__c
